summary: Essential Properties Realty Trust, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that its Board of Directors declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.32 per share of common stock for the third quarter of 2026, equivalent to $1.28 annualized. The dividend is payable October 14, 2026 to holders of record as of September 30, 2026. No advisor or board recommendation beyond the declaration was disclosed. This is a routine capital-return event rather than a special situation; the press release also recaps the REIT's 2,493-property net-lease portfolio, 14.3-year weighted average lease term and 99.6% occupancy. No arbitrage or structural angle applies.
